item.case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
item.title: Voyager One Against the References

turns.text: Make a silent 9-second widescreen fact clip about Voyager 1, using NASA's mission page as the reference: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/ . Three equal-length scenes: 'Launched: September 5, 1977', 'Jupiter flyby: 1979', 'Saturn flyby: 1980'. Keep 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible. Show the probe near Earth, Jupiter, then Saturn; match its real dish-and-boom design. Don't mix in Voyager 2's Uranus or Neptune visits.

item.tests: Tests whether a factual film matches a named reference in dates, mission identity, spacecraft appearance and scene order.

answer_sheet.Facts to include: Voyager 1 launched September 5, 1977, flew by Jupiter in 1979 and flew by Saturn in 1980.
answer_sheet.Length and scene order: 9 seconds total: three 3-second scenes showing Earth, Jupiter and Saturn in that order.
answer_sheet.Wording: Use exactly the five supplied labels. Keep Voyager 1 and Source: NASA Science visible throughout.
answer_sheet.Sound: Completely silent, with no narration, music or sound effects.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Your call, provided the spacecraft matches the real dish-and-boom design and the planets are recognizable.

must_haves: Three scenes appear in order, each lasting approximately three seconds: probe near Earth, near Jupiter, then near Saturn.
Each scene displays its corresponding date caption exactly, with 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible throughout.
The probe consistently has Voyager's large circular communications dish and projecting instrument booms, not solar-panel wings or a generic satellite body.
Jupiter is visibly banded and Saturn has prominent rings; neither is replaced with Uranus or Neptune.
The output contains no Uranus or Neptune flyby claims and no conflicting dates.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 5-second vertical educational fact video about NASA's Voyager 1. Cinematic scientific visualization, not actual spacecraft footage. Show a realistic Voyager 1 spacecraft with its large white parabolic radio dish, metallic central body and long instrument booms drifting slowly through dark interstellar space against a restrained star field. Slow gentle camera push-in, realistic documentary aesthetic. No planets nearby and no fiery engines. Calm clear documentary narrator says exactly: 'Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 entered interstellar space in 2012.' Fit the complete narration into five seconds at a brisk intelligible pace. Display a simple legible title 'VOYAGER 1' and below it 'Interstellar since 2012'. Subtle atmospheric background sound, narration clearly foregrounded.
